neighbours.label: a base-form action verb the speaker plans or instructs (after 'need to get', 'and' in an instruction); the same word used as a noun stays low
fire: We only have to get through the exam and then summer begins.
Lift the lid carefully and move the cables to the left side.
Unplug the old lamp and replace the bulb with a new one.
Click the icon twice and play the video from the start.
To win the title they must beat Arsenal on Sunday.
Pick up the counters and shuffle them before the next round.
Somehow we have to get through the winter without heating.
Grab the chairs and move them into the hall before lunch.
quiet: The exam was hard but the summer holiday began soon after.

The old lamp had a bulb that flickered all evening.

Their title hopes ended with a defeat by Arsenal on Sunday.
The counters were in a pile after the last round.
That winter without heating was the hardest we remember.
The chairs in the hall were stacked before lunch.
